bullets: Changed: In full screen, this bell sits next to the ESK name at the top left and stays there.
Changed: The Dev Update bell now shows only in full screen, at the top left beside the ESK Tracker logo and name (in ESK Bays full screen, beside the Bays title). It is gone from the side panel.
Changed: A red dot on the bell means something new. Nothing pops up any more: click the bell to read it, and the dot clears.
Changed: You can still drag the bell away; drop it near its spot and it goes back.
Changed: The sun and moon on the light/dark button are whole again.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
Changed: Light/dark shows half of each symbol with a slash between them.
New: This bell shows what changed in the ESK Tracker. It sits at the right end of the toolbar, after light/dark mode.
Changed: The toolbar icons are refresh, full screen, then light/dark ("sun / moon": press the one on the right to switch). Hover over any icon to see what it does.
Changed: The name screen now says "Enter your name", with the names right below it. Anyone can be using the tracker: tech, RN, MA or provider.
